question: Why can a student selected on 10-ms acceleration residual and frozen-task replay fail to improve closed-loop position Q?
scope: Read only the hash-locked TRAIN_C5_24 dataset, its 24 bound parent TRAIN raw runs, and already-computed scene-group OOF predictions. This analysis makes no new Plant call; no VAL/TEST data or inertia reconstruction.
predeclared_diagnostics: Recompute C5 baseline position Q from each locked TRAIN raw run as RMS Euclidean position error over its 20,001 logged states.
Compare scene-group OOF candidate vs C5 on the existing 10-ms clipped acceleration-residual target; report scene-macro and pooled RMSE.
Measure candidate-minus-C5 event-action bias, RMS, one-second-bin mean, and terminal velocity/position under an explicitly no-feedback unit double-integrator proxy.
Describe whether baseline TRAIN Q ranks with held-out one-step residual gain and action bias; treat n=24 correlations as descriptive only.
interpretation_limit: No counterfactual closed-loop trajectory is simulated. The no-feedback double-integrator output is a sensitivity proxy, never a Q prediction. No parameters or model are selected from this analysis.
